rules.1: Each side starts with one king, $1,600, and a $190 salary at the start of each turn.
rules.2: Each turn grants 3 AP. Each player gets one standard chess move per turn.
rules.3: Special pieces are placed on your side and activate on your next turn.
rules.4: With a Credit Card Knight, pieces can be bought on credit up to $3,500. Debt accrues interest each turn and is repaid automatically.
rules.5: Capturing an opponent's piece immediately pays you its purchase price.
rules.6: Salary and piece upkeep are settled at the start of each turn. You go bankrupt at -$900 or below.
rules.7: News can move an individual company's share price or the entire market.
rules.8: You may end your turn while in check. You win only by capturing the opposing king.

piece.mounted_king.name: Mounted King
piece.mounted_king.description: Moves like both a king and a knight. Capturing it counts as capturing that player's king.
piece.black_hole.name: Black Hole
piece.black_hole.description: Moves one square. Every few turns, it pulls in and removes all pieces in the surrounding eight squares.
piece.golden_pawn.name: Golden Pawn
piece.golden_pawn.description: Moves like a pawn and earns money each time it moves. If captured, it pays the opponent a large bounty.
piece.banker.name: Banker
piece.banker.description: Moves like a bishop. While alive, it improves savings returns; if captured, part of your deposits are lost.
piece.tax_accountant.name: Tax Accountant
piece.tax_accountant.description: Moves like a rook and reduces piece upkeep while owned. If captured, it pays a large tax-evasion bounty.
piece.stock_broker.name: Stockbroker
piece.stock_broker.description: Moves one square like a king. Nearby allied captures earn increased proceeds.
piece.factory.name: Factory
piece.factory.description: Cannot move. Produces pawns every few turns. When attacked, it has a 50% chance of being captured; otherwise it is destroyed.
piece.suicide_pawn.name: Suicide Pawn
piece.suicide_pawn.description: Moves like a pawn. When captured, it detonates and destroys pieces in the surrounding eight squares.
piece.bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
piece.bodyguard.description: Can teleport among the eight squares around its king. If the king is captured while the bodyguard is nearby, it sacrifices itself instead.
piece.ghost.name: Ghost
piece.ghost.description: Can move through other pieces, but each capture has only a 50% chance to succeed.
piece.magnet.name: Magnet
piece.magnet.description: Can move up to two squares. After moving, it pulls a random piece from the surrounding eight squares into a nearby empty square.
piece.warp_bishop.name: Warp Bishop
piece.warp_bishop.description: Moves like a bishop and can pay money and AP to teleport to any square of the same color.
piece.sniper.name: Sniper
piece.sniper.description: Moves one square like a king. Can capture a piece in place from up to three squares away.
piece.taxi.name: Taxi
piece.taxi.description: Can carry and move one allied piece. Its own combat strength is low.
piece.cavalry.name: Cavalry
piece.cavalry.description: Moves like a knight and earns an extra move after a successful capture. Captures can chain.
piece.fortress.name: Fortress
piece.fortress.description: Cannot move. Protects nearby allies and lets a king on its square survive one attack.
piece.fake_king.name: Fake King
piece.fake_king.description: Appears identical to a real king to the opponent. When captured, its identity is revealed and the captor loses AP.
piece.judge.name: Judge
piece.judge.description: Seals the abilities of opposing special pieces within range.
piece.pirate.name: Pirate
piece.pirate.description: Capturing a piece also steals some of the opponent's cash in addition to the normal capture reward.
piece.vampire.name: Vampire
piece.vampire.description: Its movement improves with each capture. It can eventually reach queen strength.
piece.swapper.name: Swapper
piece.swapper.description: Can spend money and AP to swap positions with an allied piece.
piece.mirror.name: Mirror
piece.mirror.description: Reflects the first attack against it once.
piece.wall.name: Wall
piece.wall.description: A cheap, immovable obstacle that most pieces cannot pass through. It is property.
piece.rental_house.name: Rental House
piece.rental_house.description: Cannot move. Increases toll income when an opponent lands on a nearby square.
piece.bankrupt_queen.name: Bankrupt Queen
piece.bankrupt_queen.description: Moves like a queen but has very high upkeep. If its owner cannot pay taxes, it changes sides.
piece.credit_card_knight.name: Credit Card Knight
piece.credit_card_knight.description: Moves like a knight. Can be bought on credit within its limit when funds are low; interest is charged each turn.
piece.venture_knight.name: Venture Knight
piece.venture_knight.description: Its strength is randomized on purchase: pawn-level on a loss, knight plus bishop on a success, and queen-level on a big win.
piece.short_seller.name: Short Seller
piece.short_seller.description: Its range and capture reward increase as the opponent's stock losses grow.
piece.chaebol_king.name: Chaebol King
piece.chaebol_king.description: A mythic upgrade for a regular king. Can acquire nearby enemy pieces for their value plus a premium.
piece.mounted_king_mk2.name: Mounted King Mk. II
piece.mounted_king_mk2.description: Moves like a king and knight. Just before capture, it can abandon its mount and let the king escape to an adjacent empty square.
